verdict.rationale: Clerk is a SaaS that holds user and customer data, so a data-use or AI-training opt-out policy is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack has nothing on training-data policies, opt-out controls, or commitments not to train on customer data. Mentions of Clerk's own machine-learning bot detection describe a feature, not a training-data control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
